> This feels a little too into the weeds of system implementation detail...

I think this is (can be) more an architecture/design question than an implementation detail.

In contrast, we do have requirement which are (important) implementation "details", such as 11.2.4 “Verify that all cryptographic operations are constant-time, with no 'short-circuit' operations in comparisons, calculations, or returns, to avoid leaking information.”
